name: Great Personality: Guardians
source:
You are a new resident in a city with ambiance-filled spaces and exceptional people. As your life in this new space unfolds, you find that your actions shape your reality and your relationships...

This game is fun, light-hearted and a few of the stories have suggestive, blush-worthy encounters (As many dating sims do!)

[From [url=http://lightgreyartlab.com/great-personality-exhibition-game/]The Official site[/url]]
translation:
你是这座城市的新居民，这里拥有充满氛围的空间和杰出的人才。当你在这个新空间中的生活展开时，你发现你的行为塑造了你的现实和人际关系……

这款游戏很有趣，轻松愉快，其中一些故事有启发性的、令人脸红的遭遇（就像许多约会模拟游戏一样！）

[来自[url=http://lightgreyartlab.com/great-personality-exhibition-game/]官方网站[/url]]
